facts.text: Tim recommended a book by Patrick Rothfuss to John.

evidence.quote: It's a book by Patrick Rothfuss and it's awesome! The way the author builds the world and characters is amazing. You should read it!

facts.text: John expressed interest in reading the book recommended by Tim.

evidence.quote: Sounds cool! I'll definitely check it out. Thanks for the recommendation!

facts.text: Tim offered to provide feedback once John had finished reading the book.

evidence.quote: No problem! Let me know what you think after you read it.

facts.text: John expressed hope that he would enjoy the book and intended to communicate with Tim soon.

evidence.quote: Me too. Talk to you soon!
